name: Kasumigaura (Japan, city)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kasumigaura city emblem in white: a crescent enclosing a smaller crescent and a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kasumigaura, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Kasumigaura city emblem — a crescent enclosing a smaller crescent and a stylised character
